PCB fits case
  1. Pcb does not overlap case, as built.
  2. Clearance of pcb/board from inner_walls of case along +x, -x, +y, -y is at least 2 mm, as built.
  3. pcb/J1 is aligned with usb_cutout of case within 0.2 mm and clears it by 0.3 mm, as built.
  Numbers I chose: margin 0.3 mm, tol 0.2 mm
